description: Rewrite-wins side of the redirects↔rewrites compose corner of SRV-ROUT-006: when a request matches a rewrite but does NOT match any redirect, the rewrite fires (status 200). Companion to ORC-032 (`prec-rewrites-redirects#go_root`) which pins the redirect-wins side. cleanUrls disabled to keep the test focused on the redirect-vs-rewrite ordering.
